observed_rate_justification.text: The B0.2 trigger asked the O109 stacked-imbalance object for buy runs by candle id alone; the recipe needs the candle's footprint rows, the call raised and was swallowed into 'no runs', so the pass rate was 0 by defect, and the earlier bound [0, 0.08] was fitted to that defect. With the rows fed from the session window's footprints and the stop below the retest low, 40 random sessions give 4 pass, 4 unknown (no higher-timeframe objective), 2 confirmation fails, 2 trigger fails, 28 context fails (pass rate 0.10); the 15-date plausibility slice gives 2 passes (0.133). The bound is widened to [0, 0.25] on those measurements; the branch stays rare by construction (28 of 40 fail the strict A-period context).
